Initial release of agent-hive: multi-agent management for OpenClaw.

- Enables creation and management of multi-agent teams with shared workspace and budget governance.
- Supports mesh networking and customizable agent-to-agent spawn permissions.
- Provides step-by-step instructions for adding new agents, managing budgets, and governance workflows.
- Not for single-agent setups or editing agent personalities (use SOUL.md directly for that).
- Includes recommendations for hub-and-spoke and mesh spawn models, with budget-based governance and demotion mechanisms.
